Soojin/Dev — quick legal greenlines below. I annotated the attached template with tracked changes; highlights here: 

1) Relocation repayment: we can keep a 6-month clawback (pro rata) but phrase it as a "relocation reimbursement repayment if employment terminates within 6 months for cause or voluntary resignation." Avoids punitive tone. Use example language: "If employment ends within six (6) months of the Relocation Payment, the Employee agrees to repay the Company a pro-rata portion of the Relocation Payment equal to (6 - months employed)/6 times the gross Relocation Payment."

2) IP assignment: keep standard assignment + moral rights waiver. For prior inventions carve-out, include a simple pre-existing inventions schedule the candidate signs and returns — less friction than long-form IP exceptions.

3) Non-solicit/competitive clause: cannot enforce broad non-competes in some jurisdictions. I recommend: 12-month non-solicitation of employees/customers + a general covenant to not solicit clients you worked on. Avoid "non-compete" label; use "restrictive covenants" and make duration/location reasonable.

4) Sign-on clawback: make the repayment tied to voluntary departure within 12 months and repayment prorated quarterly. That avoids immediate clawback and is standard.

5) Background & visa contingency: add an explicit contingency clause re: background check and visa/work authorization as condition to employment. Candidate must provide documentation before start date.

6) Data transfers: for private deployments and any customer access we add a short paragraph referencing Redwood’s Data Handling Policy and relevant access controls; candidate acknowledged for privileged roles.

I do not object to $200k base + $15k sign-on + $7k relocation (structured as you propose). Laura — if you confirm headcount approval path I’ll incorporate final language for sign-on and relocation repayment.

Attachments: Redwood_Offer_Template_v3.docx (with tracked changes)

-Markus
Markus Klein | Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

- Base salary: $200,000 per year
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time)
- Relocation: $7,000 (5k lump + 2k arrival stipend) with 6-month pro-rata repayment if you leave before that period

If the terms look good, please reply to confirm and we’ll send a DocuSign envelope. If you want to discuss any clause (e.g., pre-existing inventions or repayment wording) let me know and I’ll loop Legal.
